subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add shared group pairing admission, and should pending read-only observation be part of that contract or remain a separate plugin/agent mode?
rationale: This changes who may approve shared-room access, how group identifiers and join events are surfaced to an owner, and whether untrusted group content can enter sessions before approval.

options.title: Design Shared Admission First
options.body: Create one cross-channel approval contract with persistence, owner notification, approve/reject authority, and explicit isolation rules before channel-specific implementation.

options.title: Ship Channel-Specific Mitigations Only
options.body: Let narrower Telegram/WhatsApp warn, leave, audit, and hook work proceed while deferring owner-notified group pairing.

options.title: Keep Allowlists Only
options.body: Reject group pairing for now and document group allowlists, disabled policy, mention gating, sandboxed sessions, and listen-only plugins as the supported posture.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Admission First
recommendation.body: Create one cross-channel approval contract with persistence, owner notification, approve/reject authority, and explicit isolation rules before channel-specific implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current review, policy, and adjacent config/security routing signal among the likely owners.
